scope: Installed production UI and native API, all owner API writes blocked, no trades or playback

rules: button { min-height: 36px; border: 1px solid var(--project-border); background: var(--project-control); color: var(--project-text); cursor: pointer; }
.legacy-order-modal button { border: 0px; padding: 9px 14px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; }

.legacy-order-form footer .legacy-order-save { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-sizing: border-box; width: auto; min-width: 80px; height: var(--ds-control,36px); min-height: var(--ds-control,36px); padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--wm-control-radius); background: var(--wm-action-bg); color: var(--wm-on-primary); font-weight: var(--ds-weight-control); line-height: var(--ds-line-control,20px); }
.legacy-order-modal button.legacy-order-save:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--wm-action-hover); border-color: transparent; color: var(--wm-on-primary); }
